Let, side of the cube is 2 units
So, height of the cylinder = 2 units, & radius = 1 unit
Therefore, remaining material in the cube =(23 − π × 12 × 2)
In percentage = (8−2π)/8 × 100% = 21.42%

properties.html: A hollow right circular cylinder of internal radius 24 cm has thickness of 1cm. This cylinder is melted to form a solid right circular cylinder of equal height. What is the diameter of the new solid cylinder?

questionFeedback:
Sorry, that's not correct.
Explanation:

Hollow cylinder – Internal radius = 24cm, external radius = (24+1) = 25cm
Therefore, material present in this hollow cylinder = π × (252 − 242 ) × h cm3 Let, radius of the new solid cylinder = r cm
So, π × r2 × h = π × (252 − 242 ) × h r2 = 49 × 1, r = 7
Therefore, diameter of the solid cylinder = 7 * 2 = 14 cm
